cases.utterance: how many NBA teams are in the database?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams

cases.utterance: what is the average points scored per game by starting position?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT start_position, AVG(pts) AS avg_pts FROM game_details WHERE start_position IS NOT NULL GROUP BY start_position ORDER BY avg_pts DESC

cases.utterance: what percentage of games are won by the home team?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(home_team_wins) / COUNT(*), 1) AS home_win_pct FROM games

cases.utterance: what is the average total score per game for each season?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT season, AVG(pts_home + pts_away) AS avg_total_score FROM games GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

cases.utterance: how many games has each team played as the home team?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT home_team_id, COUNT(*) AS home_games FROM games GROUP BY home_team_id ORDER BY home_games DESC
